description: This file defines API routes for user-related operations in an Express.js application, including searching users, fetching user lists, retrieving current user info, and updating user profiles.

methods.name: GET /search
methods.description: Searches users by name or email, accessible only by admin role.

methods.name: GET /
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of users.

methods.name: GET /me
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's details, including nested merchant and brand info.

methods.name: PUT /
methods.description: Updates the profile of the current authenticated user.
